address: 49 Warrior Close, Thamesmead, London SE28 0NL (Royal Borough of Greenwich)
lead_profile_text: Existing property looking for higher return
property_situation: Owned 3rd-floor flat (small lift that sometimes breaks down), currently long-let unfurnished at £1,700/month to a family with children who moved in around March 2026. Owner cannot and will not force them out; estate-agent inspection due end of September/early October, after which she will ask about the tenant's plans. Would need full furnishing (~£5,000 via Stayful, or self-setup). Mortgage not discussed (deck's '£1,700 mortgage' is actually the rent). Name note: Monday item 'Inez'; Granola audio label 'Dauta Archibald'; Zac addressed her as 'Enis/Ennis' — full name unconfirmed.
property_type: 2-bed leasehold flat, 3rd floor with lift, Greater London
primary_blocker: Sitting tenant family she cannot legally remove (periodic tenancy under the Renters' Rights Act, no possession ground for switching to STL) — plus, not raised on the call, the Greater London 90-night rule means the full-year forecast needs planning permission for change of use
language_signals: Find out more before I take the leap.
I don't think I'm maximizing — well, I'm just exploring. I want to make sure that I'm getting the best.
I'm here to make money, not for charity in this case.
If someone wants to damage your property, you really — you just have to pray.

delay_signals.trigger_phrase: I've got tenants in there, so I'll have to give them notice ... I also need to see when the tenant can move. So I can't do the same because legally I can't kick them out.
delay_signals.context: Asked by Zac whether she had a timeframe in mind; tenant family moved in around March 2026 and the estate agent inspection is end of September/early October

delay_signals.trigger_phrase: Unfurnished. Okay, all right, so there is a setup cost to factor in
delay_signals.context: Current long let is unfurnished; Zac estimated ~£5,000 for Stayful to furnish, or a free self-setup guide; lead asked whether the fee was '£3,500' and will send pre-tenancy photos for a provisional quote

delay_signals.trigger_phrase: So Greenwich doesn't have that yet. They're — we are in consultation. ... it won't be long though before we are.
delay_signals.context: Zac wrongly said London requires a short-let licence; the actual regulatory gate for a Greater London property is the 90-night rule — letting ~281 nights/yr as modelled needs planning permission for change of use. Identified post-call and disclosed in the action plan; not discussed with the lead live

meeting_flow.opening_phrase: I thought I'd start just by understanding a bit more on your sort of current situation and situation with the property. We can go through the income projection, we go through our service, see if it lines up with what you're looking for.
rapport_topics: Joining by phone video because her laptop wouldn't connect
meeting_flow.pivot_to_business: Also, is this a property you're looking to buy? Or do you already own this property? ... What's been the sort of interest in short-term letting?
meeting_flow.income_intro: Looking at gross of about £67,600 per year. About £5,600 per month. Now there's 3 costs to factor in when having a short-term let.
meeting_flow.how_it_works_transition: Well, there's going to be a key thing that's going to be important if looking to make the transition. 2 things really, if I'm honest.
meeting_flow.pre_close_setup: What I'll do after this call is I'll just send you a summary of everything that we've spoken about. All the figures in like an action plan ... and then I'll attach our management agreement in there as well
meeting_flow.close_phrase: I mean, have you got a timeframe in mind when you're thinking of, yeah, I'd like to do this or no, I wouldn't? Or does it look appealing?

lead_responses.what_lead_said: So these percentages, are they off of the rental, or what figure do you use?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Off the gross — what a guest pays in total — working back to your monthly payout; ~£2,900/month net, about £1,200 more than the long let, or ~£800 more once ~£500/month bills are added.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: Do you service property in that area? ... In SE28 in particular?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Yes, we manage across London and in your area — we only speak to people in areas we can manage.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: Okay, and so these figures are of the general performance that you will see.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: So these clients, they're mainly business ... or are they holidaymakers?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: A mix — leisure (weekend events), university workers and visiting parents, contractors and insurance bookings; that mix is why demand is consistent all year.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: Oh, well, that was just me being curious.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: How long this property will be vacant for ... There is a tax, I call it a tax, for empty homes in Greenwich.
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: First said 3-4 empty nights a month, then corrected to about a week in four (~9 nights) at 77% occupancy.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: Access to the property, how do you normally ask? [for guests]
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Two key safes — one for guests with rotating codes, one for cleaners/contractors; owner calendar to block dates for her own visits.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: When somebody checks out ... does someone go in to inspect it?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Same-day clean with provisional inspection by the cleaner; formal inspection roughly every 3 months or when reviews dip.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: So the cleaner is the one who does the inspection.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: It's a small lift ... sometimes lift breaks down. Will someone be checking before the guests arrive?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Cleaners use the lift as much as guests, so they'd report it and guests would be told; the fix sits with the block managers.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: Would you be contacting me to contact maintenance? ... a leak, a plumbing issue, the washing machine not working
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: No — Stayful coordinates all maintenance via a Slack channel; owner approval only above £300 in a month; owner just covers mortgage, bills and safety certificates.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: Would I need to buy towels and toiletries?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: No, only pillows and duvets; Stayful supplies towels, linen and supplies once the property is fully specced.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: And you said that fee is what, $3,500, did you say? For setting up the property?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Can't say off the top of my head — send photos and I'll give a provisional quote after the call.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: I should have some up-to-date photos before it was rented.
